Definition: also (in certain tenses) prolonged οἰκτερέω from οἶκτος (pity); to exercise pity:--have compassion on.
BiblicalUsage: Oikteiro means to have compassion, to exercise pity. It occurs once, in Romans 9:15, where God says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe compassion belongs to God first, and the mercy He shows is His own free choice, not a debt He owes.
